retired_claims.claim: For n>=4 the generalized Cayley-Dickson algebra is never division over any field, with a universal zero-divisor identity.
retired_claims.reason: The located zero-divisor sources treat the standard real tower or narrower constructions and do not justify the stated arbitrary-field, arbitrary-parameter quantifiers.
retired_claims.salvage: Keep n>=4 outside the decision pipeline until a convention-complete theorem or verified identity is supplied.

retired_claims.claim: A pair of ramified places is the required n=2 division certificate.
retired_claims.reason: A single verified nonsplit completion already witnesses nonsplitting of a quaternion algebra; a full local ledger is needed for a complete split decision. The pair formulation conflated parity with certificate necessity.
retired_claims.salvage: Use local invariants with reciprocity and separate soundness from completeness.

retired_claims.claim: Gamma_p as a subgroup of compact SO(8) is itself an S-arithmetic lattice.
retired_claims.reason: The compact real projection alone is not the ambient locally compact product in which an S-arithmetic diagonal subgroup could be a lattice.
retired_claims.salvage: Construct an algebraic group and diagonal real/p-adic embedding before asking a lattice question.

retired_claims.claim: The generators act naturally on the D4 building at p.
retired_claims.reason: Triality and an eight-dimensional quadratic representation do not by themselves construct an integral Spin_8 group, a p-adic action, or identify a building quotient.
retired_claims.salvage: First prove membership in a pinned group scheme and good reduction; then determine the building.

retired_claims.claim: The Poisson intensity is exactly 24 sigma(n)/(2 ell(ell^2-1)).
retired_claims.reason: The denominator depends on the actual image, projectivization, stabilizers, and whether unit orbits or raw shell elements are sampled.
retired_claims.salvage: Define lambda empirically as |X|/|S| until the orbit quotient is proved.

retired_claims.claim: The needed second and higher moments have ready-made exact theta/Siegel formulas with the required collision-regime uniformity.
retired_claims.reason: No precise level, character, diagonal removal, or uniform error term was pinned.
retired_claims.salvage: Use N3-T01 to translate factorial moments into exact congruence counts, then identify the corresponding modular object.

retired_claims.claim: N4 can be folded into N1 before an explicit discrepancy theorem and constants are pinned.
retired_claims.reason: Certificate infrastructure can be reused, but the mathematical verification dependencies are independent.
retired_claims.salvage: Keep N4 separate and reuse only the certificate envelope.

retired_claims.claim: Finite hypercomplex closure is achieved exactly when navigation words are stratified by D and Burnside moments predict all quotient fibers.
retired_claims.reason: Closure under multiplication is part of the algebra definition, D using square roots may not be defined over F_q, defect strata need not be group orbits, and Burnside counts orbit fibers only after a genuine action and invariant map are supplied.
retired_claims.salvage: Use square-root-free Delta, define its generated finite orthogonal action, require invariance explicitly, and treat defect-flatness or holonomy as the falsifiable property.

retired_claims.claim: The similarity class of the defect Delta(x, y) carries arithmetic information beyond the quadratic-form data of the pair (x, y).
retired_claims.reason: Theorem 3.20 and Corollary 3.22 of paper/associator-defects: chi_Delta = (X-1)^4 (X^2 - tau X + 1)^2 with tau = 2 - det Gram_B(1, x, y)/(2 N(x) N(y)), and for tau != +-2 Delta is semisimple, so its similarity class is a function of the Gram matrix of (1, x, y).
retired_claims.salvage: Stratify by finer data only: the SO(C, N)-class of Delta within its similarity class (spinor-norm type), the non-semisimple cases tau = +-2, or holonomy of defect products along words (NC-N2-02).

retired_claims.claim: The SO(C, N)-class or spinor norm of a single defect Delta(x, y) carries information beyond its similarity class.
retired_claims.reason: Theorem 3.23 and Corollary 3.24 of paper/associator-defects: Delta = s_xv s_v s_yv s_(xy)v has trivial spinor norm, and over F_q a semisimple defect with N(xy - yx) != 0 has SO-class determined by tau (Wall's classification).
retired_claims.salvage: Only non-semisimple single defects (tau = -2 with g != -1, unipotent strata N(xy - yx) = 0) and products of defects along words (NC-N2-02) remain as possible non-classical signals.
